big-news.text: HMS *Prince of Wales* didn't reach Oslo yesterday: thick fog forced the aircraft carrier to turn around near Moss. Arrival has been pushed to this morning, but fog could delay it again.

A new Klassekampen/Nationen poll puts Frp at 32.9%, Ap at 19.5% and Høyre at 15.1%. Frp and Høyre would have a parliamentary majority on these numbers; Venstre falls below the electoral threshold. It's one poll, not an election result.
A man in his 30s was killed at a closed adult psychiatric ward at Drammen Hospital on Friday. Another patient, a man in his 40s, is charged with murder.
Casper Ruud is through to the Paris Masters semifinal after beating Nuno Borges. Next up is Alcaraz.

be-aware.text: There's a yellow ice warning across lowlands and valleys in Østlandet through Monday morning, with freezing fog and possible freezing drizzle. Take it carefully on roads and pavements.
If the carrier docks, expect extra security restrictions around the harbour.

fun-and-free.text: Top pick: Fjord Oslo, free light art along the harbour promenade tonight and Sunday, 18:00–23:00. Sunday is your last chance.
Oslo Zine Fest, free zine browsing and workshops this weekend; the market runs 12:00–17:00.
Ganzfeld & Skyspace tours, free visits to James Turrell's light installations in Ekebergparken on Sunday, 11:00–16:00, every half hour with a pause from 13:30–14:00.
